note: Wapello County Conservation Board nature area (HQ and nature center), 6 mi south of Ottumwa on Hwy 63 just north of the Davis County line. Gravel back-in pads about 72 ft long with fire ring and picnic table, along a road ending in a circle loop; also primitive, horse and cabin sites. Showers May 1 to September 30 only. Stocked ponds nearby, but no site is on the water. RV Life unrated. --Claude
summary: mycountyparks confirms 19 full-hookup sites (20/30/50A, water, sewer; gravel back-in pads about 72 ft) plus 3 primitive at $20, rates $32-35 ($35 in the site text), showers (none October-April) and WiFi, open March 15 to November 1, online booking with a 14-in-21-day limit and no refunds. The stored site count of 12 and the note's '9 electric/water sites' were wrong. Not waterfront stands; phone 641-682-3091 found.
